product_one_liner.value: HAAS Alert’s Safety Cloud sends real-time digital alerts about approaching emergency vehicles and roadway hazards to nearby drivers, serving public-safety agencies, roadside and work-zone fleets, and connected-vehicle partners.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as a collision-prevention service and names emergency vehicles and roadway hazards as alert sources.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is listed, including Responder Pro at $399 per year per vehicle.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly featured in HAAS Alert case studies.

employee_band.notes: Built In lists 70 total employees; Tracxn reports 56 employees as of July 2026. Both fit the requested 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Chicago, Illinois as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company’s About page says it was created in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog/media index contains product explainers, safety guidance, company news, product updates and customer content, but does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: HAAS Alert links a public Knowledge Base/help center with multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed trust center, privacy page, public documentation and blog materials did not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR. Other items it names, such as SOC 3, ISO 9001 and TX-RAMP, are not among the requested certification categories.

last_funding.notes: Volition Capital announced a growth investment on January 8, 2024. The announcement does not disclose the investment amount; 0 is used as the required numeric placeholder, not as a claim that the round was zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: On April 17, 2026, HAAS Alert announced it had secured a $50,000 scale grant, within the 18-month window. This was a grant, not a disclosed funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists three current openings, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Within the six-month window, HAAS Alert announced an August 27, 2026 Mazda partnership extending real-time safety alerts to roadside-assistance situations, and its September 2026 roundup reported new Safety Cloud deployments and an integration. These are dated product/service expansions.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available About page identifies founders but does not provide a complete, checkable current executive team or join/departure dates; no verified leadership change was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live RevOps/GTM role description names these systems in its tooling/technology context.
